title: CKM For Safe Use of SGLT2i in Type 1 Diabetes
official: Utilizing Continuous Ketone Monitors to Enable Safe Use of SGLT Inhibitors in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes
summary: This research study is being conducted to learn if wearing a combination continuous glucose monitor/continuous ketone monitor (CGM/CKM) can reduce the side effects of taking sotagliflozin (study drug) in people with type 1 diabetes.

interventions.name: Dual Continuous Glucose and Ketone Monitor

sites.f: UCSD - Altman Clinical & Translational Research Institute
